args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I would like to request a table for 12 people for next Friday, May 24, 2024, at your restaurant.

Could you please confirm availability for a group of this size and let me know the available time slots? If possible, we would prefer a private dining arrangement.

Please feel free to contact me at this email address or by phone at 327-420-4923.

Thank you very much, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
args.subject: Table Reservation Request for 12 - Friday, May 24, 2024
